name: Startups

subjectOf.text: The compliance burden attached to operating an alternative trading system, including fees, consumer protection, examination, and books and records requirements, is typically cost prohibitive for startups.
subjectOf.abstract: ATS compliance costs are typically cost prohibitive for startups.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Samuel Evans, Blockchain-Based Securities Offerings (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3411110
scope_conditions: startup firms seeking to operate an ATS

subjectOf.text: The success of the open source movement itself creates a vulnerability: major corporations can pressure smaller projects to reveal their code, then take it and exploit the work more profitably than the startup can.
subjectOf.abstract: Another problem is that the very success of the open source move- ment allows major corporations to pressure smaller projects to reveal their code, then take it and use their power to exploit the work more profitably than the startup.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Contemporary Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782198
scope_conditions: applies to small open source projects competing with resource rich incumbents
